documents.title: Bupa Global, India & UK revenue +11%, underlying profit +23%
documents.excerpt: Market unit revenue rose 11% to £3.1bn on customer growth and average premiums; underlying profit rose 23% to £154m on revenue growth and improved margins.

documents.title: Bupa Insurance Ltd combined operating ratio stable at 97%
documents.excerpt: The COR for Bupa Insurance Limited, which underwrites both domestic and international insurance, remained stable at 97%, against 94% for the Group.

documents.title: UK Care Services occupancy up to 92%
documents.excerpt: UK Care Services delivered growth in revenue and underlying profit through increasing occupancy to 92% (HY25: 90%) and disciplined cost management.

documents.title: King Edward VII and New Victoria hospitals join UK Health Services
documents.excerpt: UK Health Services revenue grew on higher customer volumes and the two hospital acquisitions; underlying profit reduced as Bupa invests to support future growth.

documents.title: Group Solvency II coverage 189%, above the 140–170% working range
documents.excerpt: Own funds £6.8bn against an SCR of £3.6bn; a 2% worse loss ratio would reduce coverage to 182%.
